```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

library(Seurat)
library(pheatmap)
library(rad)
```

# Load Figure 5 Workspace

```{r load-workspace}
load("figure_5_workspace.RData")
```

# Source project-specific scripts

```{r source-scripts}
# PROJECT_SCRIPTS is exported per README.md → Setup.
project_scripts <- Sys.getenv("PROJECT_SCRIPTS", unset = "../project_specific_scripts")
if (!dir.exists(project_scripts)) {
  stop("PROJECT_SCRIPTS not found: ", project_scripts,
       " — set the PROJECT_SCRIPTS env var (see README.md → Setup) ",
       "or place the scripts in ../project_specific_scripts/")
}
source(file.path(project_scripts, "reformat_igblast_genes.R"))
source(file.path(project_scripts, "consensus_ig_generator.R"))
```

# Panel 5A: Per-Barcode Isotype Read Counts (Visium Tonsil Spatial)

Strip plot showing per-barcode Log10(read counts) for each immunoglobulin heavy chain locus gene
in a 10x Visium tonsil spatial transcriptomics dataset (Engblom et al.).

```{r panel-5a-data-prep}
# IGH locus depth analysis (chr14: 99839968-100127783)
# ig_locus_res: annotated depth data for IGH locus
# chr14_depth: per-base depth across chromosome 14

# Subset to IGH locus
# ig_locus_res <- res[locus == "IGH" & pos >= 99839968 & pos <= 100127783,]
# ig_locus_res[, c('locus_subtype','ig_class') := tstrsplit(canonical_gene, "_")]
```

```{r panel-5a-visium-depth-plot}
# Visium depth histogram across IGH locus
p <- ggplot(ig_locus_res,
  aes(x = pos, weight = visium_depth, fill = ig_class)
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 500, position = "stack") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x/1e6, 2), " Mb")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
  theme_pubclean() + scale_x_reverse()
```

```{r panel-5a-nbc-depth}
# NBC (Nojima B-cell culture) depth
# nbc_depth <- data.table::fread(file.path(Sys.getenv("NBC_DEPTH_DIR"),
#                                          "nbc_chr14_t2t_mapont.depth.csv"))
# setnames(nbc_depth, old = 'depth', new = 'nbc_depth')

q <- ggplot(ig_locus_res,
  aes(x = pos, weight = nbc_depth, fill = ig_class)
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 500, position = "stack") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x/1e6, 2), " Mb")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
  theme_pubclean() + scale_x_reverse()
```

```{r panel-5a-rageseq-depth}
# RAGEseq depth
# rsq_depth <- data.table::fread(file.path(Sys.getenv("NBC_DEPTH_DIR"),
#                                          "rsq_chr14_t2t_mapont.depth.csv"))
# rsq_ig <- rsq_depth[pos >= 99839968 & pos <= 100127783,]
# ig_locus_res <- dplyr::left_join(ig_locus_res, rsq_ig[,c('pos','rsq_depth')], by = 'pos')

r <- ggplot(ig_locus_res,
  aes(x = pos, weight = rsq_ncpm, fill = ig_class)
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 500, position = "stack") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x/1e6, 2), " Mb")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
  theme_pubclean() + scale_x_reverse()
```

# Panel 5D: Hierarchically Clustered Isotype Heatmaps (All Clones)

```{r panel-5d-all-clones-heatmap}
# All clones heatmap
if (exists("plot_mat")) {
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    plot_mat,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    scale = "row",
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    border_color = NA,
    gaps_col = nrow(constant_clones),
    main = "Isotype Composition: All Clones"
  )
}
```

```{r panel-5d-switching-clones-heatmap}
# Class-switching clones only
if (exists("mult_iso_mat")) {
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mult_iso_mat,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    scale = "row",
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    border_color = NA,
    main = "Isotype Composition: Class-Switching Clones"
  )
}
```

# Panel 5F: Per-Clone Isotype Heatmaps (4 Representative Clones)

Clones 2277, 86, 5725, 7445.

```{r panel-5f-clone-2277}
# Clone 2277: VDJ: IGHV1-18/IGHD5-24/IGHJ4
clone_2277_heatmap <- clone_2277_data[,.N, by = c('c_gene','barcode')] %>%
  dcast(barcode ~ c_gene, fill = 0)

mat <- as.matrix(clone_2277_heatmap[, -1])
rownames(mat) <- clone_2277_heatmap$barcode
anno <- data.frame(
  barcode_idx = seq_len(nrow(clone_2277_heatmap)),
  row.names = clone_2277_heatmap$barcode
)

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mat,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  main = "Clone 2277, VDJ: IGHV1-18/IGHD5-24/IGHJ4",
  number_format = "%.0f",
  angle_col = 315,
  number_color = "black",
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  border_color = NA,
  display_numbers = TRUE
)
```

# Panel 5G: Spatial Maps of Representative Clones

```{r panel-5g-isotype-colors}
isotype_cols <- c(
  IGHM  = "#8B7A7A",
  IGHD  = "#6A1F00",
  IGHG3 = "#19A83E",
  IGHG1 = "#2B7DC6",
  IGHG2 = "#FF2D0F",
  IGHG4 = "#F06A1A",
  IGHE  = "#F1B44C",
  IGHA1 = "#A873C8",
  IGHA2 = "#7B2DAF"
)
```

```{r panel-5g-clone-labels}
# Clone labels with VDJ genes and CDR3/junction_aa
clone_labels <- unique(
  clones_to_plot_dedup[, .(clone_id, vdj_genes, junction_aa)]
)
clone_labels[, label := paste0(vdj_genes, "\nCDR3: ", junction_aa)]
clone_labeller <- setNames(clone_labels$label, clone_labels$clone_id)
```

```{r panel-5g-spatial-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Final spatial plot of 4 clones on tonsil tissue (section 12 / sample_id == 1)
p <- ggscatter(
  bg_plot[sample_id == 1],
  x = "x_pix_scaled",
  y = "y_pix_scaled",
  shape = 19,
  color = "grey",
  size = 2,
  legend = "right",
  alpha = 0.4
) +
  geom_point(
    data = clones_to_plot_dedup,
    aes(x = x_pix_scaled, y = y_pix_scaled, fill = c_gene),
    shape = 21,
    size = 2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~clone_id,
    labeller = labeller(clone_id = clone_labeller)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = isotype_cols) &
  coord_fixed()

p
# ggsave("clone_spatial_plot.svg", plot = p, width = 12, height = 8)
```
